thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (P1): Cross-region routing anomaly detected. Symptoms: surge in 5xx and high p99 latency for requests that should remain in eu-west-1. Affected endpoint: /v1/generate (hosted). Pager: @oncall-ryan.
oncall-ryan: I'm on it. What are the initial metrics and scope?
sre-lina: Spike starts ~03:10 UTC. Heatmap shows ~12-18% of eu-west-1 traffic being routed to us-east-1. RTT up ~200-350ms for those. Also seeing increased TLS handshake failures from some edges.
network-ops-jamal: Edge LB telemetries show unusual weight shifts after the policy rollout. The latency-based balancer seems to have increased weights to us-east-1 for multiple prefixes.
eng-runtime-maya: We deployed route-policy-v2 at 03:05 UTC as an experiment to reduce p95, with a rule that shifts weight on latency but pins certain prefixes.
sre-lina: Can you share the rule text? Need to validate matching.
eng-runtime-maya: Pasted: ```json
{
  "policy": "route-policy-v2",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "latency_ms > 50", "then": "increase_weight:us-east-1:20"},
    {"if": "path_prefix == '/v1/generate'", "then": "pin_region:eu-west-1"}
  ]
}
```
network-ops-jamal: The evaluation engine treats query-string variants differently; it looks like the prefix matcher isn't normalizing query parameters, so requests like "/v1/generate?model=gpt-x" don't hit the pin and fall through to the latency rule.
support-kim: We're seeing customer complaints: EU tenants reporting timeouts and slow responses. Dedicated/reserved clusters unaffected. Hosted customers impacted.
product-ana: We need a short comms line for customers: "We're investigating elevated latency and errors for EU hosted API; mitigation in progress." Hold until mitigation confirmed.
oncall-ryan: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback route-policy-v2, 2) apply emergency pin override for /v1/generate to eu-west-1, 3) implement guardrail to prevent auto-weighting on pinned prefixes. Who can action 1 & 2?
eng-runtime-maya: I'll perform the rollback and push override. Command: ```/infra deploy routes --policy route-policy-v1 --force --region eu-west-1```
network-ops-jamal: I'll also post an ops override to lock traffic: ```curl -X POST https://ops-api/overrides -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prefix":"/v1/generate","region":"eu-west-1","ttl":3600}'```
incident-bot: Action recorded: rollback initiated by eng-runtime-maya. Incident window start: 1794600123.
(03:20 UTC) eng-runtime-maya: Rollback completed, override applied. No errors in deploy logs.
sre-lina: Observing metrics: error rate drops ~68% within ~90s post-rollback, latency p99 improves. Small residual (~1-3%) remains due to stale route caches at some edges.
support-kim: Sent initial customer notifications with the short message. Collected support tickets from impacted accounts; top three are flagged as high-touch.
product-ana: Draft ready for status page and customer follow-up; will publish after we confirm impact window and tenant list.
oncall-ryan: Assigning post-incident owners: Lina + Jamal for RCA (matching and edge evaluation), Maya for runtime rule fixes and tests.
sre-lina: I'll own the RCA and impact quantification. Jamal to gather LB decision traces and rule-eval logs.
network-ops-jamal: Preliminary root cause: prefix matcher used substring matching after recent change, failing to strip query strings. Will gather sequence of commits and timeline.
eng-runtime-maya: I'll add stricter path normalization and unit/integration tests to prevent query-string bypass. Also adding telemetry counters for pinned_vs_shifted per prefix.
incident-bot: Status: mitigated. Partial restoration confirmed. Postmortem required (P1). SLA: brief elevated latency and error counts for hosted EU customers.
product-ana: Please compile a list of impacted tenants for the follow-up communication.
support-kim: Collating tickets and attaching request IDs/timestamps now.
oncall-ryan: Handoff: oncall remains engaged for 30m. If anomaly resurfaces, re-open P1. Paging oncall-sre for daytime follow-up.
eng-runtime-maya: Keeping override for 30m to ensure caches flush, then will deploy the safer matching change.
sre-lina: RCA checklist items: - fix prefix matching logic - ensure query normalization in matcher - reduce cache TTLs for route decisions or add invalidation hook - add alert when cross-region shift for pinned prefixes > 5%
incident-bot: End note: mitigation applied, rollback completed. Incident window end recorded at 1794600923. Please create postmortem draft under /incidents/postmortems/1794600123-routing-rca when ready. :white_check_mark:
